title: Fresh Start! Valtryek's Evolution!
overview: Valt arrives in Barcelona, where he meets a junior BC Sol player Kit Lopez and a BeyTrainer named Raul.

title: Fighting Spirit! Berserk Roktavor!
overview: Since he missed his first day at BC Sol, Valt has to battle for the one remaining slot on the roster. His opponent is his old friend Rantaro!

title: Drain Fafnir! Winding Up!
overview: BC Sol holds internal tryouts to select their squad against Sunbat United. To represent the club, they'll have to defeat team captain Free De La Hoya.

title: Whirlwind! Tempest Wyvron!
overview: The match against Sunbat United starts, and Valt and Rantaro get the nod for BC Sol. They find themselves facing a familiar face.

title: Surprise Attack! Kinetic Satomb!
overview: BC Sol and Sunbat United continue their face off. Valt and Silas show how much they've evolved since their last match.

title: Squad Shake Up!
overview: In the aftermath of the match with Sunbat United, BC Sol shakes up its A-team roster. Silas and Django each make a difficult decision.

title: Journey to the Top!
overview: Stan blames Valt for Django's decision. Despite tensions on the team, it's soon time for tryouts for the European League.

title: Season Opener! European League!
overview: The European League kicks off with BC Sol facing German team Top Wand. Valt makes a new friend, Cuza, but soon winds up facing him in the arena.

title: Alter Cognite! The Shape Shifter!
overview: With BC Sol and Top Wand tied, Valt and Cuza face off for a rematch. Meanwhile, Theodore Glass continues to try and recruit Free to his team.

title: Free to Launch!
overview: BC Sol's victory only brings more tension. Silas wants more play time, resentment towards Valt and Rantaro grows, and then Free makes an announcement.

title: BC Sol! A Team Divided!
overview: With Free gone, Valt and Rantaro are promoted to BC Sol's first string for their matches against the Swedish team, but thing's don't go well.

title: The Return of Doomscizor!
overview: BC Sol faces French team AS Gallus. Valt and Rantaro get thrown off the roster when they’re caught talking with Daigo, a player on the opposing team.

title: Twin Scythes! Double Strike!
overview: Back on the A squad, Valt faces his old friend Daigo in two intense matches. They've both come a long way from Beigoma Academy Bey Club.

title: Attack! Maximus Garuda!
overview: The European League matches continue and BC Sol faces off against the Royals, whose star player has a grudge against Silas.

title: Ghasem! The Airborne Blader!
overview: After Valt and Rantaro's matches, Ghasem and Silas face each other again. Meanwhile, Valt receives some disturbing news about an old friend.

title: The Search for Shu!
overview: Valt, Rantaro, Daigo and Wakiya head to Mexico, where Shu went missing. After meeting up with Cuza, they learn about the Snake Pit Organization.

title: Shadow Magic! The Snake Pit!
overview: Still inside the Snake Pit, Valt and his friends face the masked Shadow Bladers, who somehow have Beys exactly like their own!

title: The Underground Maze
overview: Valt and his friends take on the Snake Pit's Bladers: a psychic, an acrobat, and an arctic aficionado. To find Shu, they all have to win!

title: Secret Fire! Red Eye!
overview: Azure Eye is a powerful opponent, but Valt's learning fast. Then he and his friends face Red Eye and Violet Eye in a battle royal!

title: New Teammates! New Rivals!
overview: Back in Spain, BC Sol starts training for the World League, but some of the Bladers aren't happy when an old friend arrives.

title: Joshua vs. the Space Ninjas!
overview: Famous actor and Big Five Blader Joshua Burns arrives to film his new movie, and Valt, Rantaro and Cuza are cast as the villainous Space Ninjas!

title: Blast Jinnius! Caller of Storms!
overview: Shooting for the movie continues, but Wakiya has his sights set on fighting Joshua for real stakes, not just on the set.

title: Infinity Stadium! Raul's Challenge!
overview: BC Sol needs a new trainer. When they find a seasoned veteran, he's invited for a trial period, but Kris has some family history with him.

title: World League! Setting the Stage!
overview: The World League is about to begin, and everyone is busy with their final preparations. Joshua reveals his reason for joining the Raging Bulls.

title: Showdown! Surge Xcalius!
overview: Valt receives an unexpected letter from Xander, who's in Brazil working towards earning a spot on the highly esteemed SB Rios.

title: Genesis Reboot!
overview: BC Sol and the Royals face each other in a rematch for the ages. With help from Rickson and Raul, Valt trains to master his Genesis Reboot move.

title: Worlds Collide! Home Turf!
overview: The next World League battle, between SB Rios and Sunbat United, is scheduled for Japan! Which means Valt and his friends get to go home for a visit.

title: Vampire! Deep Caynox!
overview: Valt and his friends head to France to cheer Daigo and his team on in the big showdown between AC Gallus and BC Galleon.

title: The Fortress! Shelter Regulus!
overview: For their battle against SB Rios, BC Sol head to Brazil, where they get into some trouble at the Bey Carnival.

title: Collision Course! To the Finals!
overview: The semi-finals begin, with BC Sol facing SB Rios and AS Gallus battling the Raging Bulls. With advancement on the line, no one's holding back!

title: Big 5! Breaking Through!
overview: Valt and his friends are still battling for a place in the finals. Both Cuza and Valt face off against Ren Wu, one of the elite Big 5 Bladers.

title: Unrivaled! Triple Saber!
overview: Daigo and Joshua Burns battle for a spot in the finals and Xander faces his ultimate rival, Valt. Everything is riding on these matches!

title: The World League Final!
overview: The World League finals begin at last, with BC Sol facing off against the Raging Bulls. Lui is only one of many familiar faces making a reappearance!

title: Full Power! Spring Attack!
overview: The battles continue, and the tension is rising. With the final match looming, Free faces Silas while Valt goes up against Joshua.

title: To the Podium!
overview: The World League final's final match: Silas versus Joshua, BC Sol versus the Raging Bulls. After all their hard work, there can only be one winner!

title: Lúinor vs. Spryzen!
overview: Red Eye returns to stake his claim as the ultimate Blader, accepting a match against Lui. Red Eye's secret identity is revealed, shocking everyone.

title: Challenge of Champions!
overview: A new global Blading tournament is announced: the International Blader's Cup! He's already qualified, but Valt vows to train even harder than ever.

title: Requiem Project! Spryzen Unleashed!
overview: Free returns to BC Sol, but not all of his former teammates are ready to bury the hatchet. Shu is overtaken by a mysterious power.

title: Emperor of the Underground!
overview: The International Blader's Cup is about to begin, but Valt and Kit get distracted by a shady underground arena where fierce Bladers compete.

title: Bow Down! Boom Khalzar!
overview: The Cup kicks off with Valt chosen to face off against Kurt in an epic battle for the ages.

title: Colossus Hammer! Twin Noctemis!
overview: The battles for the Cup continue, with the Snake Pit alumni squaring off against each other. Boa faces Shu, then Norman battles Clio and Cuza.

title: BC Sol Scorcher!
overview: Wakiya's suspicions about the Cup grow while the battles rage on. Silas prepares a new technique as Valt and Cuza square off.

title: White Hot Rivals!
overview: Shu and Kurt battle for victory while Joshua prepares to fight Free once again as the winners rise and the losers continue to fall.

title: Epic Evolution! Strike Valtryek!
overview: The leaderboards aren’t looking too great for BC Sol's Bladers. To survive the next round, Valt, Silas and Cuza will have to level up or go home!

title: Spryzen the Destroyer!
overview: In the fourth round, Valt finally faces his former best friend Shu and his infamous Bey, Requiem Spryzen. Valt will have to give it his all to win.

title: No Limits! Free vs. Lui!
overview: In the wake of his match with Shu, Free tells Valt about a dangerous new training method before facing Lui.

title: Full Force! Charging Up!
overview: Free and Lui's battle concludes, and Norman and Shu face each other in a Snake Pit rematch. Valt faces Boa for a chance to advance to the next round.

title: Teamwork! To the Semi-Finals!
overview: Cuza and Valt each face off against the Emperor himself: Kurt! Boa decides to leave the Snake Pit, but not before telling Valt a shocking secret.

title: The Fierce Four!
overview: Four Bladers advance to the semi-finals of the International Blader's Cup. Shu faces off against Lui, while Valt prepares for his match against Free.

title: Breaking Point! Bursting Through!
overview: After his match with Free, Valt's family and friends come to cheer him on for the final round of the tournament: a rematch against his oldest friend.

title: A Champion Is Crowned!
overview: Valt faces Shu one last time, with everything on the line: the title of World's Strongest Blader, his pride and his friend's very soul. Let it rip!
